jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Please Note

You are not required to report into a Mosaic office; however, there is travel to client locations across the United States required for this role. (~50%)
Geographic flexibility: This position is open to candidates residing anywhere in the US.

Position Overview

The Project Manager (PM) leads one or more teams of Mosaic professionals to deliver projects on time, on budget, and within a defined scope that meets the client’s stated business objectives. The PM owns the day-to-day operation of the project and manages it in alignment with the Mosaic Project Management Framework and its supporting processes.

The PM works within a cross-functional project governance team. Mosaic’s governance roles are a collaborative partnership rather than a hierarchy: the PM reports to the Director, Portfolio Management for performance, development, and assignment, and is accountable to the assigned Portfolio Manager for the delivery of each project.

The PM ensures the team has access to the Mosaic and client tools and resources needed to complete the defined scope of work, proactively managing risks and issues to remove blockers to team success. Across the project life cycle, the PM interacts with Mosaic and client team members and client leadership, consults stakeholders to shape recommendations and decisions, and monitors and reports project health.

Roles and Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the Project Manager role are as follows:

Collaborative Governance

Facilitate decision-making for the project among the project’s governance team.
Monitor project financial performance in collaboration with the Project Controller, including revenue realization, margin attainment, forecast accuracy, contract compliance, burn, and the information required for invoicing.
Identify emerging client relationships, contractual, financial, and delivery risks requiring executive intervention and escalate them to the Portfolio Manager, Strategic Advisor, and Executive Sponsor through defined escalation paths.
Forecast project resource requirements and work with Resource Management and Portfolio Management to identify staffing needs, transitions, and emerging capacity constraints. Facilitates timely onboarding and offboarding decisions to maintain delivery continuity.
Collaborate with the project governance team to coach key client stakeholders.
Prepare and present the project update for the internal Monthly Portfolio Review.

Project Management Expertise

Apply Mosaic Project Management processes on every project and document any deviation through the PMO Exception process.
Translate the Statement of Work into a detailed project schedule, communication plan, and supporting project documentation using Mosaic PMO processes and templates.
Facilitate internal Mosaic project team onboarding and the Client Project Planning Kick-off.
Obtain formal client approval of the project plan.
Manage schedule, scope, and budget against the Statement of Work, adjusting work plans as business needs change.
Maintain the risk log, issue log, and weekly status reporting in the Mosaic Status Tracker.
Manage change through the Change Request process and secures formal sign-off through the Deliverable Acceptance process.
Apply PMI-aligned practices across schedule, cost, change, risk, and issue management, and selects the delivery methodology (Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, or Hybrid) appropriate to the work.
Complete project closeout, including facilitating the Lessons Learned process, finalizing the information required for invoicing, and confirming administrative closure with the Project Controller.

Business / Industry Acumen

Develop working knowledge of the client’s operations, processes, and financial drivers in collaboration with the Strategic Advisor.
Build familiarity with the client’s industry and maintains awareness of internal and external client dynamics that may affect the project.
Collaborate with third-party vendors and client executives to meet project goals.
Leverage approved productivity, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve delivery quality, efficiency, and project insight while operating within the security, privacy, and compliance requirements of both Mosaic and the client.
Identify potential scope expansion or follow-on work and raise it to the Portfolio Manager and Client Executive.

Effective Communication

Establish and execute a communication plan that informs client, Mosaic, and stakeholder audiences in a timely manner of the events and issues that concern them.
Drive proactive, transparent communication across all project stakeholders, including early disclosure of unfavorable news.
Facilitate the resolution of team conflict.
Coach, mentor, and encourage project team members to take positive action and accountability for their assigned work.
Maintain and enforce team responsibilities and accountabilities.
Collaborate with the project governance team to identify team members’ strengths and development areas and allocates work to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

To effectively respond to client and project needs, roles and responsibilities will vary and may include additional responsibilities not listed.

Skills And Experience

Three to five years of experience managing projects for a consulting firm or B2B service provider, or successful completion of the Mosaic Project Manager Apprentice Program (PMAP).
Demonstrated track record leading projects valued between $50K and $3M for client organizations.
Demonstrated success managing the day-to-day operational aspects of a project, including timeline, budget, and scope.
Demonstrated success managing day-to-day client interactions, including managing relationships and resolving project issues.
Experience leading projects through the full life cycle with a proven ability to deliver within the outlined scope, budget, and timeline.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to convey difficult or sensitive information tactfully.
Strong documentation and data collection skills.
Demonstrated ability using project management software such as MS Project, along with recognized methodologies and best practices.
Advanced skills in the Microsoft 365 suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint).
Demonstrated ability to operate successfully in an ambiguous environment and to solve problems creatively.
Demonstrated ability to delegate effectively to optimize team performance.
Highly organized with strong time management skills; resourceful and effective under pressure.
Ability to move between analytical work and interpersonal engagement as the situation requires.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience in Energy & Utilities or another regulated client environment.
Experience delivering training, organizational change, or systems integration projects.
Working knowledge of Agile delivery within a hybrid methodology.
Experience applying AI tools within enterprise security and compliance constraints.

Education and Certification

Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Management, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
Master’s degree in Project Management, Business, Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Management, or a related field preferred.
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

Working Relationships

Physical Demands: While performing the essential functions of this position, the employee is required to communicate effectively; remain stationary for extended periods; operate a computer and other standard office equipment; view computer screens and read electronic and printed materials; and stand, walk, and reach. The position may also require extended periods of sitting while traveling.
Work Environment: Work is performed in a variety of environments, including remote, office, client-site, and field locations, depending on business and client needs. Travel is an essential function of this position and may be required on a regular basis to support client engagements, meetings, training, and other business activities. Employees must be able to travel as required to fulfill the essential functions of the position.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Mosaic is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us stronger, and we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and other job-related factors. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, provincial, or local law.

Reasonable Accommodations

Mosaic is committed to creating an environment where all qualified individuals have an equal opportunity to succeed. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and applicable law. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

At Mosaic, we are invested in our people and are proud to offer a competitive total compensation package. Compensation decisions are made based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, consulting experience, education and training, demonstrated competencies, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed reflects a good faith estimate of the compensation for this role at the time of posting. A reasonable national base salary range for this position is $95,000.00 - $165,000.00 USD annually, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. This position is eligible to participate in a bonus program of up to 8% of annual compensation, subject to individual and organizational performance. In addition to salary and bonus eligibility, Mosaic offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health and wellness benefits, a Flexible Time Off program, paid holidays, a discretionary 401(k) match, and for US based employees, participation in the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

Salary Range Notice: The salary range listed for this position applies to candidates located in the United States. Compensation for candidates outside the U.S. will be determined based on local market conditions, legal requirements, and other job-related factors.

We regularly review our compensation practices to ensure they remain competitive, compliant, and aligned with our values. Additional details on Mosaic’s U.S. benefit package can be found at the following LINK.

jobs.title: Web Development Project Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
Egypt – Remote
Employment:
Full-time
Experience:
Minimum 4 years of relevant project management experience
Working Hours:
3:00 am – 11:00 am Egypt time / 10:00 am – 6:00 pm Sydney time

Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and proactive Web Development Project Manager
to join our growing team.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time.
You will be responsible for coordinating projects across different teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time.
We are looking for someone who does more than simply update tasks. You should be comfortable taking ownership of projects from start to finish
, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

What You Will Do

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within our project management systems.
Monitor deadlines and ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines.
Communicate project progress, risks, delays and required decisions clearly to management.
Run project meetings and ensure actions, owners and deadlines are clearly documented.
Follow up with team members on outstanding deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed deadlines.
Work closely with management to prioritise projects and allocate resources effectively.
Improve existing workflows, processes and project management systems.
Develop and maintain project documentation, SOPs and reporting where required.
Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

What We Require

Minimum 4 years of professional website development project management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.
Ability to identify problems early and propose practical solutions rather than simply escalating issues.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Technically fluent in dev workflows, including sprint planning, QA processes, and coordinating between design, development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Experience using project management platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, ClickUp, Jira or similar
.
Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.

Highly Regarded

Experience working in a digital marketing agency, technology company or similar fast-paced digital environment
.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.
Experience with Monday.com
.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful in this role if:
Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.
Project information is accurate and consistently maintained.
You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organised and efficient as a result of your involvement.

The Person We're Looking For

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging unrealistic timelines and holding people accountable while maintaining positive working relationships.
Most importantly, you have a strong ownership mentality
. When a project is assigned to you, you take responsibility for moving it forward and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Compensation: Up to 60 000 EGP
depending on experience and assessment.

jobs.description:
Company Description
A.M. Fabricators/WDI is a long-standing Kawneer distributor, providing commercial aluminum window products to the glass and glazing industry for over 40 years. Established in 1988 by Mark Aronoff, the company combines deep industry expertise with Kawneer’s quality and innovation. This partnership has enabled A.M. Fabricators/WDI to deliver reliable products and services to commercial construction projects across the United States. The company has earned a strong reputation as a leading distribution partner, known for its technical knowledge, customer service, and commitment to long-term client relationships.
Role Description
The Estimator and Project Manager is a full-time remote role responsible for managing the lifecycle of commercial aluminum window projects, from initial bid to completion. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing architectural drawings and specifications, preparing accurate cost and project estimates, and developing budgets for materials and labor. The role involves coordinating with internal teams, vendors, and clients to clarify project requirements, timelines, and deliverables, while tracking project progress and addressing issues proactively. The Estimator and Project Manager will also maintain detailed project documentation, monitor costs against budgets, and support decision-making to keep projects on schedule and within scope.
Qualifications

Cost Management and Budgeting skills to develop, track, and control project financials.
Construction Estimating and Project Estimation skills to interpret plans, quantify materials, and prepare competitive bids.
Strong Communication skills to collaborate with clients, vendors, and internal teams in a remote environment.
Experience in construction, glass and glazing, or commercial building products is highly beneficial.
Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural drawings and specifications.
Proficiency with estimating software, project management tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Relevant education in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Network Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: 9/2/26

Anticipated Posting Close Date*:
12/2/26

Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Senior Program Manager, Network Infrastructure

The Senior Program Manager, Network Infrastructure will play a critical role in scaling the Fastly global network by leading the execution of our most impactful Network Infrastructure projects. Acting as a strategic bridge across Network Operations, Supply Chain, Data Center Provisioning, Data Center Infrastructure, Finance, and Legal, you won’t just track deliverables; you’ll drive complex, large-scale deployment plans to completion. You will join our high-impact Program Management Infrastructure team, reporting to the Senior Manager, and have a direct, tangible influence on the growth and success of Fastly’s global infrastructure.

What You'll Do

Drive the end-to-end development and execution of build and deployment plans.
Lead complex, large-scale infrastructure projects, including new site builds, site augments, and decommissioning efforts.
Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration between Infrastructure Acquisition Managers, Network Operations, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, Finance, Legal, and other partners, ensuring clear accountability and successful delivery.
Establish and maintain reporting frameworks to provide transparent visibility on deployment timelines, risks, and project health to stakeholders across the organization.
Proactively identify critical path bottlenecks, risks, and blockers, escalating issues with data-driven mitigation strategies.
Analyze project workflows to identify and implement opportunities for standardizing and automating processes, ensuring faster and more reliable infrastructure delivery.
Manage vendor and partner relationships to ensure the timely procurement and delivery of critical hardware and services.
Collaborate as a core member of a high-impact team dedicated to building and scaling the world’s most performant edge computing network.

What We're Looking For

Proven track record of at least 5-7+ years driving large-scale infrastructure programs within cloud services, CDN, OTT, data center, or telecommunications environments.
Technical fluency in data center and network infrastructure architecture, including power specifications, hardware deployment, and physical layer components.
Experience working in a Production Engineering environment with a focus on Network Engineering, Acquisition, or Delivery.
Proficiency in advanced project management tools (Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet) and data visualization to track milestones and capacity.
Experience in process analysis and improvement to drive operational efficiency and standardization.
Experience with global capacity planning, supply chain logistics, and managing hardware deployment lifecycles.
Strong stakeholder management, ability to navigate ambiguity, and the leadership to drive consensus across diverse engineering teams.
Experience in incident management or post-mortem analysis to improve long-term system reliability.
Ability to translate complex technical requirements into actionable project roadmaps for non-technical stakeholders.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

PMP or other project management certification
Experience with Dell and Hyve hardware
Experience with Arista and Ciena networking hardware

Work Hours

This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager. There is a preference for candidates to be located near one of our offices below, but it is not required.

San Francisco, CA
Denver, CO
New York, NY

The estimated salary range for this position is $142,630.00 to $195,000.00.

Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs.

Benefits

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 12 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days.

This individual will lead a team of support personnel and coordinate the resources required to launch new and complex projects with the goals of achieving timelines, staying within budget, and driving standardization within our network. The Project Manager will manage medium to large capital projects with significant schedule commitments. The Project Manager will lead and coordinate schedule of multiple vendors at the same time, as well as interface at all levels of the organization.

This role requires up to 80% nationwide travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Manage new and existing programs, successfully delivering difficult projects and goals across multiple organizations

3+ years of driving process improvements experience

jobs.title: Privacy Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

Legal and Compliance manages all legal and regulatory matters, including privacy, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, employment law, intellectual property, government relations, and claims, while supporting Coursera's and Udemy's platforms and partnerships. The Privacy Program Manager is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the company's global privacy program across products, platforms, and business functions. Working closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, this role translates privacy and data protection requirements into scalable operational processes, governance, and technical controls that embed privacy by design across the organization. The role owns core privacy operations, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, vendor privacy reviews, and data subject rights requests, while driving automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement to enable the business to meet privacy obligations efficiently at scale.

Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Procurement, and other stakeholders to conduct privacy reviews for new products, features, vendors, and business initiatives, embedding privacy by design into business processes.
Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) and a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), or equivalent privacy certification.

Nice to haves:

About The Job:

This position will serve as the project manager for a project entitled “The costs of caring: The health penalty of carework occupations” at the University of Minnesota School of Public Health. This project is a multi-site partnership of academic institutions that aims to measure the impact of paid care work on the health of care workers. The project includes both a quantitative component at the University of Minnesota and a qualitative component that will be conducted at the University of Washington.

Duration:
Temporary at 50% time for 12 months may be extended depending upon work performance and available funding.

Project Coordination – 80%

Tracking the progress of research projects from inception to completion (utilizing tracking spreadsheets, work plans and GANTT charts)
Serving as a point of contact and leading project-related communication with funders, research partners, and collaborating organizations
Coordinating agendas and documentation for regular team meetings
Scheduling internal meetings as well as meetings with external partners
Updating grant reports, budgets, and related administrative materials
Assisting in the preparation and submission of grant proposals and applications
Providing administrative support for the principal investigator and other team members

Conducting literature reviews specific to particular carework team projects
Supporting applications for data access and the completion of data use agreements and IRB documentation
Collaborating with team members in preparation and submission of reports, publications, and data for presentation at professional conferences and meetings
Integrating citations into research products utilizing citation software (e.g., Zotero)

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

Experience leading continuous-improvement initiatives for supply planning processes and reporting.
Experience partnering with engineering teams to build internal tools.

Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) keynotes reach millions of viewers and shape how the world understands cloud and AI. Behind every keynote is a team that turns complex technical ideas into clear, compelling stories for our biggest stages. We are looking for a Program Manager II to run the programs that bring these keynotes to life, coordinating across executives, content creators, product teams, and design partners to deliver presentations on time and at a high quality bar. If you are organized, resourceful, and excited by the challenge of managing high-visibility programs where the details matter, this role puts you at the center of how AWS communicates its most important innovations.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end keynote development program, defining milestones, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and keeping production on schedule across multiple workstreams.
Coordinate with executives, product teams, content leads, and design partners to align on themes, messaging, and priorities for each keynote.
Identify process gaps in how keynotes are built and implement improvements that raise quality and reduce cycle time.
Define and monitor program metrics to measure delivery performance, then use those insights to inform planning for future events.
Apply generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to streamline documentation, status reporting, and program analysis.

You start your morning checking the keynote production timeline and flagging any deliverables at risk of slipping. Mid-morning, you run a working session with content leads and design partners to review the latest script draft and lock down next steps. After lunch, you pull together a status update for executive stakeholders, summarizing progress and open decisions that need their input. Between meetings, you are refining the intake process for new keynote requests, looking for ways to make the workflow smoother for the next cycle.

Our team sits within AWS and exists to ensure the most important stories resonate on the biggest stages, delivered by our most senior executives. We partner closely with product, engineering, design, and executive communications teams to produce keynotes for events like re:Invent and other major technology conferences. Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

jobs.description:
Additional Location(s):
N/A

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

About The Role

Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across medical technology, enterprise operations, digital health, clinical workflows, and customer-facing solutions. Boston Scientific is advancing science for life by enabling AI innovation through clear governance, accountable decision-making, and responsible AI practices that scale across the enterprise.

As a Senior Project Manager, Responsible AI, you will act as a process steward to evangelize Responsible AI (RAI) governance and operationalize the cross-functional governance model for AI across Boston Scientific. You will translate high-level policies and workflows into a highly adopted, well understood, scalable, metrics-driven program that ensures appropriate governance for every AI initiative across divisions, regions, and functions.

In this role, and using change enablement practices, you will assist teams hands on to achieve full organizational implementation, adoption, and practice of Responsible AI processes. You will work closely with the Responsible AI team and Council, AI Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Data and AI Governance, Legal, Privacy, Security, Regulatory, Quality, Compliance, and divisional business stakeholder teams to embed Responsible AI controls into AI solutions and products while enabling teams to move with speed and clarity.

Work model, sponsorship, relocation:

At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring employees to be in our local office at least three days per week. Boston Scientific will not offer sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Responsible AI process stewardship and hands-on project enablement

Develop deep expertise and enablement readiness for the end-to-end Responsible AI process, requirements, decision points, roles, artifacts, controls, and escalation pathways.
Partner hands on with AI project teams from intake through approval and ongoing governance, helping each team understand requirements, complete required activities and documentation, engage the right reviewers, resolve issues, and reach full compliance efficiently.
Act as a trusted guide and primary process resource for project teams, translating Responsible AI policies and compliance requirements into clear, practical actions tailored to the project’s use case, risk profile, development pathway, and business context.
Proactively identify blockers, unclear requirements, missing inputs, dependencies, and decision needs; coordinate with Responsible AI, Legal, Privacy, Security, Regulatory, Quality, Compliance, Data and AI Governance, Enterprise Architecture, and other stakeholders to keep projects moving.

Role definition, operating model, and scalable playbook

Define and continuously refine the responsibilities, engagement model, success pathways, standard work, service expectations, and decision/escalation mechanisms based on practical experience supporting AI projects.
Establish a repeatable operating model for how process stewards engage with AI initiative owners, governance reviewers, and compliance functions, including entry criteria, checkpoints, handoffs, communication expectations, and completion criteria.
Collaborate closely with the change enablement team to incorporate the RAI process within existing governance processes; design a framework that enables high process adoption, including creating a comprehensive playbook, including process maps, role guides, checklists, templates, FAQs, examples, training content, facilitation guidance, and lessons learned.
Design the role and playbook for enterprise scale so the capability can be replicated across divisions, regions, and functions while maintaining consistent Responsible AI standards and outcomes.
Identify existing and design new cohorts through which a successful implementation of the capability and role as well as a global RAI enablement community can be delivered at scale

Compliance performance, process improvement, and program delivery

Drive toward 100% adherence to applicable Responsible AI process requirements for supported projects, with clear visibility to project status, required actions, accountable owners, risks, exceptions, and completion.
Track and analyze process performance, including compliance rates, cycle times, aging, rework, recurring questions, handoff delays, and bottlenecks; use insights to reduce avoidable process delays while maintaining governance rigor.
Partner with Responsible AI process owners and cross-functional compliance teams to identify opportunities to simplify, clarify, standardize, and improve workflows, documentation, guidance, and controls.
Build and present implementation plans, operating proposals, progress updates, metrics, risks, and recommendations to program leaders and stakeholders, demonstrating value and informing decisions about expansion of the capability.

Change enablement, communication, and capability building

Evangelize the Responsible AI process through clear, credible communications that explain the value of the RAI enablement role, how teams should engage, and how strong governance can enable responsible innovation with greater speed and predictability.

This position is uniquely placed where novel test methodology creation, silicon execution, and datacenter/field testability intersect. It offers a chance to influence the future of computing.

In this role, you will work closely with DFX engineers, development managers, and cross-functional partners across silicon design, verification, software, manufacturing ops, and datacenter to lead innovation programs and process initiatives. Developing and managing project schedules, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure programs remain on track for both build and deployment landmarks is essential. You will participate in key build reviews and technical forums, managing scope changes efficiently in collaboration with engineering partners. Acting as the primary liaison between DFX Engineering, Silicon Design, Software, Manufacturing, and datacenter/field operations teams is a significant part of the role. Proactively identifying technical and schedule risks and developing mitigation strategies in partnership with engineering will be crucial. Providing clear status updates and communicating issues to leadership with recommendations to support tough trade-offs is encouraged. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Familiarity with DFX methodologies including IST is a strong plus
Knowledge of APIs and data analytics for program management and metrics dashboards

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional programs within OTS Service Desk, operating across a global ecosystem of Operations, Product, TPM, and Field Engineering teams. This role owns the end-to-end program lifecycle — from ambiguous problem statements to scaled execution — driving operational excellence, service delivery improvements, and customer experience outcomes across multiple regions and time zones. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can independently structure complex problems, define program roadmaps, and deliver measurable results without waiting for perfect information. You will partner with global SD Operations leaders to identify gaps in service delivery, forecast accuracy, remote resolvability, and workforce planning — translating insights into actionable programs with clear milestones and accountability. The role requires influencing without authority across Product, TPM, and Field teams to align priorities, secure commitments, and drive adoption of SD-led initiatives even when competing interests exist. You will lead negotiations with cross-functional stakeholders on resource allocation, process ownership, and operational trade-offs — maintaining composure and earning trust through data-driven advocacy and transparent communication. This leader will own executive-level reporting, business reviews, and program narratives that connect operational metrics to strategic outcomes, ensuring leadership has clear visibility into progress, risks, and decisions needed. You will drive continuous improvement by identifying systemic inefficiencies, designing scalable mechanisms, and embedding them into SD operations — from training frameworks and quality programs to automation adoption and self-serve deflection strategies. The role demands high ownership — you treat every program as your own, proactively remove blockers, escalate decisively when needed, and hold cross-functional partners accountable to shared commitments without damaging relationships. Experience managing global stakeholder landscapes (L6–L8), navigating matrixed organizations, and delivering results in fast-paced, high-volume IT support environments is essential. The successful candidate brings 7+ years of program management experience, strong analytical skills, exceptional written and verbal communication, and a demonstrated ability to earn trust, influence senior leaders, and deliver results at scale in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end lifecycle of global SD programs — from scoping problems to driving execution and delivering measurable outcomes across AMER, APAC, EU, and LATAM. Partner with Operations, Product, TPM, and Field Engineering leaders to align priorities, negotiate resource allocation, and drive shared accountability across matrixed teams. Identify systemic gaps in service delivery, remote resolvability, and workforce planning — designing scalable mechanisms to improve efficiency and customer experience. Lead SD readiness for large-scale technology rollouts and migrations, ensuring forecasting accuracy, self-serve deflection, and operational hard stops are aligned to protect capacity. Own executive reporting, business reviews, and program narratives connecting operational metrics to strategic outcomes. Drive CSAT/DSAT analysis, root cause investigations, and corrective actions in partnership with Training and Quality teams. Champion continuous improvement through automation adoption, process redesign, and structured training programs that build a skilled, peak-ready global workforce. jobs.description:
Description

The Technical Program Manager III, BIM-PLM Integration, owns data intake for new DC design products within Design Services — serving as the primary gatekeeper who evaluates designs for BOM translatability, collaborates on Engineering changes and ad hoc business requests, and drives end-to-end product introduction from concept through PLM registration and BOM integration.

Works across Design Engineering, collaborates with BIM Design Managers and BOM Program leads, and owns process and governance development for the CAD-to-PLM pipeline — establishing clear handoffs across BIM and PLM. Scope spans CAD/BIM extraction and auditing, PLM data structuring, design change categorization and intake, ECO/ECR management, cross-functional synchronization, BOM QA across procurement systems, and global standardization.

Ideal Candidate: A bridge between BIM requirements and PLM with firm understanding of Revit/BIM and data-centric processes, knowledge of DC electrical and mechanical equipment (power distribution, cooling, switchgear, PDUs, rack infrastructure), and experience maintaining a data program built on BIM data extraction at scale.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

CAD/BIM Data Extraction & Model Governance: Extract and validate Engineering BOMs from native CAD/BIM models — auditing parametric readiness, structuring facility sub-assemblies (MEP/HVAC, power), and ensuring metadata fidelity into PLM.

Data Governance & Process Development: Define and enforce data standards (shared parameters), author governance frameworks and SOPs for the CAD-to-PLM pipeline, and drive continuous process improvement using cycle-time data to reduce rework and strengthen data integrity.

New Product Introduction (NPI) — Drive end-to-end product introduction through NPI phase-gates, evaluating incoming DC designs for BOM translatability and routing by complexity from initial design evaluation through PLM registration, BOM structuring, and operational handoff.

Design Intake & Impact Analysis — Own the single intake point for new DC designs, equipment categories, and engineering intercepts. Classify incoming changes by type, scope, and BOM impact; conduct cross-system ripple analysis across power, cooling, structural, and networking domains; and maintain an intake registry from concept through PLM registration.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Deep knowledge of BOM management — including BOM hierarchy design, 150% BOM architecture, configuration logic, BOM derivation pipelines (Engineering BOM → Manufacturing BOM), and the end-to-end lifecycle from creation through maintenance, deprecation, and obsolescence
5+ years of hands-on experience with Autodesk Revit, including family authoring, shared parameters, and model management
Proven track record of building quality assurance frameworks that prevent downstream errors in complex data ecosystems

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Expert-level Revit family authoring — parametric modeling, adaptive components, nested families, type catalogs
Familiar with data center infrastructure programs.
Familiarity with Quality Management System (QMS) frameworks, PDCA methodology, and ISO 9001 principles applied to engineering data governance

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of customer projects from order acceptance through final delivery, with primary responsibility for engineered-to-order (ETO), configured-to-order, and other custom customer orders. Projects typically involve pumps, engineered pumping solutions, and related equipment that are designed, configured, manufactured, tested, and documented to meet customer-specific technical, commercial, quality, and delivery requirements. These orders may include unique engineering requirements, customer specifications, documentation and testing requirements, third-party or subcontracted components, and changes in scope during execution.

The Project Manager serves as the primary cross-functional leader for these orders, coordinating Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Applications Engineering, Sales, and other functions to ensure customer commitments are met. The role owns the overall project plan and drives execution against schedule, cost, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and customer expectations from order handoff through shipment and project closeout.

This position requires a strong project leader and change agent with a proven track record in high-mix, low-volume manufacturing and engineered-to-order (ETO) environments, capable of creating accountability across functions, proactively managing project risk, resolving execution issues, and driving process improvement and standard adherence throughout the full lifecycle of an order.

KEY SUCCESS DELIVERABLES

Deliver customer projects on time, within budget, and to specification, while identifying lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Build and lead effective cross-functional project teams with clear accountability for project deliverables.
Manage complex ETO and custom customer orders from order acceptance through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing, documentation, shipment, and closeout.
Proactively identify and manage project risks related to schedule, cost, technical requirements, supply chain, quality, and customer scope.
Document project results, monitor performance metrics, and drive improvement in on-time delivery and overall project execution.
Establish clear and proactive communication with customers and internal teams. Document project issues, customer negotiations, clarifications, and changes in scope.
Establish and drive operational excellence standards around contract review, order entry, requests for quote, order status, product information, change management, and special customer requirements.

TEAM MANAGEMENT

Lead cross-functional teams from project scoping and order handoff through delivery and closeout of all project objectives.
Establish an effective meeting and operating cadence to create team alignment, accountability, and ownership.
Coordinate activities across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Applications Engineering, Sales, and other functions required to execute customer orders.
Provide guidance to Applications Engineers for proposal development, order handoff, and SOP compliance.
Drive timely resolution of technical, commercial, operational, and supply-chain issues that could affect customer commitments.

PLANNING

Facilitate development of functional area plans and create integrated project plans and schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing, documentation, and delivery.
Translate customer and contractual requirements into clear project milestones, deliverables, responsibilities, and timing.
Work with functional leadership to ensure adequate resources are assigned to project teams to meet all project deliverables.
Identify long-lead materials, critical engineering activities, customer approvals, testing requirements, and other potential constraints early in the project lifecycle.

PROJECT MONITORING & EXECUTION

Manage project schedules using critical path methodologies.
Lead risk assessment of schedule, financial, technical, quality, and contractual requirements; create risk mitigation and contingency plans.
Track project progress against key milestones and publish metrics and status reports as required.
Build cross-functional engagement with the CIRCOR Project Management System.
Identify deviations from project scope, schedule, cost, or customer requirements and drive timely corrective action.
Manage customer-driven engineering and specification changes throughout project execution.
Negotiate changes to project scope of work with the customer and key subcontractors; ensure changes are incorporated into the project schedule and that incremental costs are identified and recovered.
Support effective project closeout, including resolution of outstanding customer requirements, documentation, lessons learned, and financial performance.

COMMUNICATION

Serve as a key point of coordination for customer communication during project execution.
Provide timely and transparent communication of project status, risks, decisions, and required actions to all stakeholders.
Conduct milestone reviews and executive status meetings as required.
Effectively communicate tradeoffs and required decisions when customer changes, technical issues, or operational constraints affect cost or delivery.

Skills

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Effective planning, communication, and presentation skills.
Strong project leadership skills with the ability to drive results through cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Ability to forge strong relationships with customers and internal business partners.
Excellent conflict management and problem-solving skills.
Ability to navigate ambiguous situations and create clarity, alignment, and accountability.
A responsive, customer-focused mindset driven to meet both external and internal customer needs.
An action-oriented approach to managing responsibilities that results in meeting challenging, time-bound objectives.
Strong commercial awareness and ability to understand the cost and schedule implications of customer requirements and scope changes.

Education And Experience

BS degree in Business, Engineering, or related field.
Proven track record managing engineered-to-order, custom, or complex customer projects, preferably in a high-mix, low-volume industrial manufacturing environment.
Proven experience managing projects ranging from $500K to $5.0M in size.
Minimum of 3 years of experience managing projects and leading cross-functional teams.
Experience coordinating engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, testing, and customer requirements through the lifecycle of an order.
Management of global projects desired.
PMP certification is a plus.
Knowledge of oil & gas and power generation markets is a plus.
Strong skills in Microsoft Project.
Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, IFS, JD Edwards, Oracle).

Language Skills

Excellent communication and presentation skills for all levels of the organization.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical specifications, contractual requirements, and legal documents.

Mathematical & Financial Skills

Understands budgeting, costing, and financial concepts and can manage project performance against financial objectives.
Ability to understand the financial impact of scope changes, schedule delays, engineering changes, and other project execution issues.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to interpret technical instructions presented in mathematical, written, or diagram form and deal with multiple abstract and concrete variables.

jobs.title: Senior Humanitarian Access Safety and Security Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Job Overview

The Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security Manager (SHASSM) supports safe, effective and efficient access to and by people in need of humanitarian assistance. The role reports to the Senior HASS Coordinator and supports field locations in implementing programs aligned with the IRC’s risk appetite and strong commitment to the safety and security of our staff. The Snr HASSM ensures access and security risks are identified on time, mitigations are implemented, and staff are appropriately briefed on the security risk environment, relevant SOPs and Contingency Plans. The role will have a strong focus on providing capacity building to the Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security teams in each Field location. The Snr HASSM will also cover gaps in the HASS team in field locations and deputize for the Senior HASS Coordinator when requested.

Key Responsibilities

Humanitarian Access Management

Identify barriers to access and support the HASS and program teams in developing mitigation strategies.
Provide technical support to program teams in assessing the suitability of establishing operations in new locations
Develop relationships with local authorities as needed and other power brokers within IRC’s implementation areas.
Promote and support the integration of humanitarian access approaches into program design and implementation.
Constantly monitor available sources to collect, compile and report information to the Senior HASS Coordinator including incidents and trends pertinent to humanitarian access in areas of operations
Support key field management teams to develop and implement community engagement strategies that promote acceptance and access.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to ensure that IRC’s visibility strategy and profile support principled humanitarian access.

Safety and Security Risk Management

Provide technical support to the field offices and program teams on all policies, procedures, guidelines and planning for staff safety, and program continuity in Ukraine.
Contribute to the development of and updating of Security Risk Assessments (SRA) for field sites.
Contribute to the development and updating of Field Security Management Plans (SMP), including all associated contingency plans and SOPs.
Monitor the rollout and implementation of SOPs and contingency plans at a field level ensuring compliance.
Ensure effective security risk management plans for cross-border access to field sites, principally through border crossings to/from Moldova.
Ensure contingency plans for hibernation, relocation, and evacuation are known to ield staff and exercise regularly.
Ensure that all program locations and routes are routinely assessed by the HASS team to identify access and security risks in a timely manner.
Ensure all field locations meet requirements for safety and security supplies and equipment including hibernation kits, first aid kits and emergency communications.
Ensure the emergency warden systems in field locations are fit-for-purpose and tested regularly.
As requested by field teams, conduct risk assessments in new geographic locations identified for program implementation.
Deploy alongside program teams to high-risk areas and establish deployment protocols commensurate to the risk assessed.
Conduct field visits to all IRC field offices and cover HASS teams gaps when requested.
Deputize the Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety & Security Coordinator as requested.
Demonstrated experience operating at a senior / strategic level with the ability to deputize for and cover the most senior in-country security role

Capacity Building

Liaise with the HASSM to jointly draft the annual capacity building plan based on the key risks faced by frontline staff.
Support the delivery of training to field staff; deliver trainings as needed and relevant.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to identify the capacity-building needs of the HASS team based on the needed capacities and skills to ensure safe, secure and principled humanitarian access.
Provide on-the-job capacity building for the HASS team through mentoring, coaching, and guidance.
Support the HASS team to strengthen and expand the capacity of field teams to prepare and respond in a timely manner to emerging emergencies
Support the HASS team to deliver staff awareness and training sessions.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator to develop and deliver training on Critical Incident Management.
In coordination with the Senior HASS Coordinator, develop a plan to promote national talent within the team to assume more responsibility.

Context Monitoring and Reporting

Monitor open sources and available information to identify changes in the context of heightened tensions.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator in ensuring field teams are appropriately advised of the risk environment, and preparedness actions are implemented.
Support the HASS team to compile regular context updates to monitor issues that could impact program delivery.
Work closely with the HASS team to ensure all incidents and accidents are reported on IRC’s online system within 48 hours of the incident occurring.
Support the Senior HASS Coordinator in scenario planning exercises.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

Reports to: Senior Humanitarian Access, Safety and Security Coordinator

Supervises:
None.

Key Internal Relationships: HASS Manager, HASS Officers and Assistants, Field Coordinators

Key External Relationships: Local partners, INGOs operating in field locations, Security and Access Working Groups, local authorities and stakeholders relevant to program delivery

Requirements

Job Requirements

Work Experience

A University degree in a subject relevant to humanitarian action or security such as International Relations or Political Science.
Minimum of 5 years humanitarian safety, security and access management experience with an INGO, including demonstrated capability in planning, organizing and executing security operations in the field.
Demonstrated security leadership skills including operating independently with limited oversight. This role is a senior-level experienced and independent contributor.
Demonstrated experience managing safety, security and humanitarian access across multiple high-risk or conflict-affected country contexts is required Strong understanding of the humanitarian principles required.
Demonstrated experience negotiating and expanding humanitarian access in active conflict / frontline environments Knowledge of communications technology including satellite communications.
Strong experience as a trainer.
Ability to provide dynamic verbal and written briefings on short notice.
Able to express ideas and concepts clearly and persuasively to internal and external stakeholders.
Exceptional organizational and coordination skills
Excellent relationship-building, interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively represent IRC at forums and with external stakeholders
Experience working successfully with local stakeholders such as local and international NGOs and government with sensitivity and diplomacy.
Knowledge of GIS and Google Earth is desirable.

Languages Required/Preferred

Fluency in English required.

Ability To Travel

This role requires at least 40% travel within Ukraine and therefore will not be suitable for applicants that are not willing or able to deploy to field locations regularly.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

We empower organizations to achieve parity by offering flexible solutions that standardizes design and operations of secure spaces regardless of location, size, or customer.

This team is looking for an experienced project management professional to lead direct reports to meet strategic initiatives through cross functional teams to drive the planning, design and construction activities of secure office spaces to support the US Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) communities.

This role requires someone with strong relationship building skills who will work with stakeholders on strategic planning/projects within Region Services organization. Some examples of project work may include support of delivering new or expanding current secure spaces.

You must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical discussions to troubleshoot project management issues and remove barriers to project success.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally analytical and has a continuous improvement mindset. They have program management skill sets and a strong communicator (verbally and written) to collaborate to solve cross-organization challenges creatively.

The vision is to provide global controllership across a portfolio of secure spaces for AWS customers operating in highly-regulated environments by driving efficiency and standardization. We work backwards from unique customer regulations, access to classified systems, and user experiences to offer solutions that enable customers to deliver upon their mission. Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As AWS expands its Global Data Center footprint our infrastructure standards continue to rise. We seek a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive remediation of issues found during our audit program. You'll work with multifunctional regional teams in the Americas, driving the teams to mitigate and ultimately remediate risks from both Amazon owned Data Centers and Colocation Data Center providers. jobs.description:
SOVOS

Enterprise Project Manager

Managed & Professional Services·Full-Time·UK/AMS/ESP

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're transforming how global enterprises navigate regulatory complexity. We're looking for an Enterprise Project Manager to join our European Professional Services team, with the ability to be based in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, or Spain. This is a senior delivery role for an experienced PM who understands the complexity of enterprise SaaS implementations and brings deep familiarity with tax compliance, e-invoicing, or regulatory technology. You'll own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-country implementations for enterprise clients across EMEA, operating with a high degree of autonomy and directly impacting client satisfaction and the reputation of Sovos Professional Services in Europe.

More Specifically, You Will

Own end-to-end project delivery for enterprise e-invoicing and tax compliance implementations across multiple EMEA countries simultaneously.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for client stakeholders, from project teams to C-suite sponsors, throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and status reports; proactively surface risks and drive resolution before they become escalations.
Lead structured project governance, including weekly status meetings, monthly steering committee sessions, and go/no-go decision processes, in alignment with Sovos delivery methodology.
Manage project scope rigorously; identify, document, and drive change orders when client requests exceed agreed SOW boundaries.
Coordinate cross-functional Sovos resources (Solution Consultants, Technical Consultants, SAP specialists, Regulatory, and Product teams) to deliver against project commitments.
Track and report project hours against PS retainer balances; proactively communicate burn-down status and initiate retainer expansion conversations at appropriate thresholds.
Leverage AI-assisted project management tools to improve delivery efficiency, automate status reporting, and surface risk patterns across the client portfolio.
Manage Hypercare periods post-go-live and execute formal project handover to Sovos Customer Support.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of PS delivery methodology, SOW templates, onboarding playbooks, and project governance frameworks.

What You Bring to Sovos

You've built solid experience delivering enterprise SaaS implementations in a client-facing Professional Services environment, with demonstrated expertise managing complex, multi-stakeholder implementations in the tax compliance, e-invoicing, VAT, or regulatory technology space.
Demonstrated success managing projects with enterprise clients (500M+ revenue) across multiple countries and time zones concurrently.
Experience with SAP-integrated implementations (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or Process Orchestration) is strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience with retainer-based PS engagements, including scope management, change order discipline, and hour burn-down governance.
Familiarity with EMEA e-invoicing mandates, including France (PPF/PDP), Germany (XRechnung/Peppol), Poland (KSeF), and/or Turkey (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv), is a significant advantage.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills: able to build trust with client executives and navigate competing priorities without losing delivery momentum.
Solid commercial acumen: you understand the relationship between project delivery, revenue recognition, and margin, and manage accordingly.
Proactive risk management mindset: you identify and escalate issues early, document decisions, and drive accountability without being asked.
Clear, structured communicator (written and verbal) capable of adapting tone and detail level for technical teams, client project managers, and executive sponsors alike.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in fast-moving, multi-mandate environments where priorities can shift quickly.
Proficiency with project management tooling (e.g. Cloud Coach, Salesforce, Jira, or equivalent PSA/CRM platforms); comfort with AI-assisted workflows to enhance delivery speed and insight generation is a plus.
Demonstrated project management capability through certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or equivalent proven delivery experience is valued.
Equivalent experience to a Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
Fluency in English required; proficiency in French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Polish is a meaningful advantage given the client base.
Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. The Commercial Enablement Program Manager manages the creation, coordination, governance, measurement, and continuous improvement of programs developed by the Commercial Learning & Enablement team. Working closely with the Sr. Director and broader Enablement team, this role establishes the project plans, operating systems, calendars, tools, reporting, and governance required to move programs from intake through development, launch, reinforcement, measurement, and maintenance. This individual contributor also owns the team’s SharePoint environment, supports program content development, and serves as the team’s AI and enablement technology lead.

Experience supporting development and deployment of training, onboarding, continuous learning, coaching, playbook, or sales enablement programs.
Experience administering program governance, intake processes, operating systems, measurement plans, SharePoint, or content-management standards.
Experience with Microsoft 365, project-management tools, reporting platforms, learning technologies, and AI-enabled productivity solutions preferred.
Strong program and project management skills, including translating requirements into clear plans, milestones, owners, deliverables, and measures of success.
Ability to build and improve operating systems, governance processes, intake workflows, calendars, trackers, templates, and documentation standards.
Strong organizational, coordination, analytical, reporting, problem-solving, written communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate content development across Enablement team members, subject matter experts, and cross-functional partners.

Strong SharePoint administration, knowledge-management, content-governance, taxonomy, and information-architecture capabilities.

office

Create executive-ready presentations, reports, and recommendations that translate complex information into clear business insights.
Partner with cross-functional teams across product management, project management, analytics, sales, marketing, delivery, and transformation to support strategic initiatives.

How Lenovo’s services business and GPS portfolio are structured, managed, and grown.
