SOVOS

Enterprise Project Manager

Managed & Professional Services·Full-Time·UK/AMS/ESP

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're transforming how global enterprises navigate regulatory complexity. We're looking for an Enterprise Project Manager to join our European Professional Services team, with the ability to be based in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, or Spain. This is a senior delivery role for an experienced PM who understands the complexity of enterprise SaaS implementations and brings deep familiarity with tax compliance, e-invoicing, or regulatory technology. You'll own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-country implementations for enterprise clients across EMEA, operating with a high degree of autonomy and directly impacting client satisfaction and the reputation of Sovos Professional Services in Europe.

More Specifically, You Will

Own end-to-end project delivery for enterprise e-invoicing and tax compliance implementations across multiple EMEA countries simultaneously.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for client stakeholders, from project teams to C-suite sponsors, throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and status reports; proactively surface risks and drive resolution before they become escalations.
Lead structured project governance, including weekly status meetings, monthly steering committee sessions, and go/no-go decision processes, in alignment with Sovos delivery methodology.
Manage project scope rigorously; identify, document, and drive change orders when client requests exceed agreed SOW boundaries.
Coordinate cross-functional Sovos resources (Solution Consultants, Technical Consultants, SAP specialists, Regulatory, and Product teams) to deliver against project commitments.
Track and report project hours against PS retainer balances; proactively communicate burn-down status and initiate retainer expansion conversations at appropriate thresholds.
Leverage AI-assisted project management tools to improve delivery efficiency, automate status reporting, and surface risk patterns across the client portfolio.
Manage Hypercare periods post-go-live and execute formal project handover to Sovos Customer Support.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of PS delivery methodology, SOW templates, onboarding playbooks, and project governance frameworks.

What You Bring to Sovos

You've built solid experience delivering enterprise SaaS implementations in a client-facing Professional Services environment, with demonstrated expertise managing complex, multi-stakeholder implementations in the tax compliance, e-invoicing, VAT, or regulatory technology space.
Demonstrated success managing projects with enterprise clients (500M+ revenue) across multiple countries and time zones concurrently.
Experience with SAP-integrated implementations (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or Process Orchestration) is strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience with retainer-based PS engagements, including scope management, change order discipline, and hour burn-down governance.
Familiarity with EMEA e-invoicing mandates, including France (PPF/PDP), Germany (XRechnung/Peppol), Poland (KSeF), and/or Turkey (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv), is a significant advantage.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills: able to build trust with client executives and navigate competing priorities without losing delivery momentum.
Solid commercial acumen: you understand the relationship between project delivery, revenue recognition, and margin, and manage accordingly.
Proactive risk management mindset: you identify and escalate issues early, document decisions, and drive accountability without being asked.
Clear, structured communicator (written and verbal) capable of adapting tone and detail level for technical teams, client project managers, and executive sponsors alike.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in fast-moving, multi-mandate environments where priorities can shift quickly.
Proficiency with project management tooling (e.g. Cloud Coach, Salesforce, Jira, or equivalent PSA/CRM platforms); comfort with AI-assisted workflows to enhance delivery speed and insight generation is a plus.
Demonstrated project management capability through certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or equivalent proven delivery experience is valued.
Equivalent experience to a Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
Fluency in English required; proficiency in French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Polish is a meaningful advantage given the client base.
Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Description

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

Family Health Centers of Southwest Florida (FHCSWF) the 340B Program Analyst supports the organization’s 340B Program by monitoring compliance, conducting audits, analyzing financial and operational data, and identifying opportunities to improve program performance and resource utilization. This position works closely with the 340B Compliance Administrator, Pharmacy, Finance, IT, Compliance, and 340B oversight leadership to ensure the program operates efficiently, maintains regulatory compliance, and maximizes the organization’s financial and operational value. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, knowledge of pharmacy operations and 340B requirements, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for leadership. Adheres to Corporate Compliance program, by reporting improper or unethical conduct, violation of applicable laws, regulations or program requirements

Detailed Duties And Responsibilities

Assist the 340B Compliance Administrator with internal, external, and regulatory 340B Program audits.
Conduct regularly scheduled 340B audits and monitoring activities to identify compliance risks, discrepancies, and reconciliation issues.
Investigate identified discrepancies and work with appropriate departments to resolve issues promptly.
Maintain complete and organized documentation, reports, audit findings, and supporting records for compliance and audit purposes.
Monitor program activities and identify trends or processes that may create compliance risk.
Assist with the development and implementation of corrective action plans when deficiencies are identified.
Maintain current knowledge of 340B Program requirements and apply that knowledge to daily monitoring and program oversight.
Perform data extraction, manipulation, validation, and analysis to support 340B compliance, financial performance, and operational monitoring.
Develop and maintain reports that measure program volume, financial value, utilization, compliance, and performance.
Create reports that educate staff and assist management in understanding and monitoring the financial impact of the 340B Program.
Develop additional reports and analytical tools as needed to identify trends, monitor performance, and support decision-making.
Maintain appropriate reporting packages and historical data for compliance, audit, and management purposes.
Construct financial metrics and performance indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.
Perform covered-entity-specific gross financial analyses and provide recommendations to improve program performance.
Track financial performance over time, identify root causes of unfavorable trends, and recommend strategies to improve program stability and sustainability.
Review and refine monthly 340B cost-savings reports, including purchasing, replenishment, inventory, and dispensing activity.
Monitor, analyze, and report on contract pharmacy 340B activities.
Review contract pharmacy performance, utilization, compliance, financial results, and potential liabilities.
Prepare financial reports outlining the financial impact of contract pharmacy arrangements for applicable covered entities and leadership.
Identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities to improve contract pharmacy efficiency and financial performance.
Make recommendations regarding contract pharmacy processes, utilization, and resource allocation.
Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve 340B processes, systems, workflows, and resource utilization.
Assess system capabilities and recommend improvements that strengthen compliance, reporting accuracy, efficiency, and program performance.
Collaborate with IT and other departments to improve data integrity, system functionality, reporting, and automation.
Analyze operational processes to identify inefficiencies, duplication, financial leakage, and opportunities for cost savings.
Recommend and assist with implementation of process improvements that enhance the overall value of the 340B Program.
Monitor the effectiveness of implemented improvements and quantify financial or operational outcomes when possible.
Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal departments, including Pharmacy, Finance, IT, Compliance, Operations, and Leadership.
Provide data, reports, analysis, and insights to support organizational decision-making and other business-unit needs.
Collaborate with the pharmacy, compliance, and 340B oversight councils to establish and monitor monthly, quarterly, and annual audit metrics.
Participate in 340B meetings, committees, and oversight activities as assigned.
Communicate complex financial, operational, and compliance information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support staff education by developing reports, presentations, and other materials related to 340B compliance and program performance.
Develop and maintain a high level of expertise in the 340B Program, including applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, pharmacy operations, and emerging best practices.
Expand knowledge of the healthcare and pharmacy industries and apply that knowledge to identify opportunities for program enhancement.
Monitor changes in 340B regulations, guidance, industry practices, and technology that may affect program operations.
Share relevant knowledge and recommendations with leadership and the 340B oversight team.

Requirements

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Good interpersonal skills.
Ability to conduct oneself professionally.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and demonstrated ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies and trends.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial, operational, and compliance information.
Demonstrate a commitment to ongoing professional development and maintaining current knowledge of 340B regulations, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.

Training And Experience

High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field is a plus.
One (1) to three (3) years of experience in healthcare, pharmacy, finance, data analysis, auditing, compliance, administrative support, or a related field preferred.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Engineer, Operational Analyst to drive the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s autonomous aircraft systems. This role is pivotal in evaluating the mission effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our autonomy solutions across multiple platforms and domains. You will work closely with engineering, product development, and defense stakeholders to inform design trade-offs, assess system performance, and optimize mission capabilities.

This position requires a deep understanding of military operations, wargaming, modeling & simulation (M&S), analytic techniques, and operational analysis techniques. Your work will directly shape Shield AI’s strategy by identifying how our AI-powered platforms can best serve the evolving needs of modern warfare.

Develop and execute operational analysis strategies to assess the effectiveness of autonomous aircraft in real-world military scenarios.
Lead modeling, simulation, and wargaming efforts to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.
Work closely with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational insights into design decisions and system improvements.
Conduct trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance under varying operational conditions and threats.
Utilize advanced modeling & simulation tools (e.g., AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python) to develop high-fidelity mission models.
Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor effectiveness, and autonomy-driven decision-making to optimize mission success.
Collaborate with DoD stakeholders, operators, and warfighters to understand mission needs and align system capabilities with operational requirements.
Support concept of operations (CONOPS) development for new AI-driven aircraft capabilities.
Identify emerging threats and operational challenges, ensuring Shield AI’s systems remain ahead of adversary capabilities.
Develop and present technical reports, briefings, and recommendations to senior leadership, customers, and government agencies.
Leverage modern compute and development best practices (e.g., scalable cloud/HPC workflows, containerization, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing) to build, run, and iterate high-fidelity simulation and analysis pipelines quickly and reliably.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation (M&S), or military operations research.
Expertise in military mission analysis, operational planning, and wargaming methodologies.
Proficiency with AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, or other M&S tools used for aerospace and defense applications.
Deep understanding of air combat, ISR, electronic warfare, or autonomous systems in contested environments.
Experience working with DoD stakeholders, warfighters, and government agencies to align capabilities with mission requirements.

Excellent communication and briefing skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership, customers, and military personnel.

Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.

company Mars location Montpellier, Occitanie, France posted 8 Sept

**Location:**
Based at our global headquarters in Aimargues, located just 30 minutes from the city of Montpellier. Our campus offers direct access to major European hubs while letting you enjoy 300 days of sunshine a year!

Royal Canin

Permanent (CDI)
With E-Commerce set to represent a major piece of all Petfood sales in the near future, Royal Canin is embedding its business in a truly omnichannel landscape. As our Global E-Commerce & Demand Performance Business Analyst, you will stand at the very heart of this transformation with influence and impact. Your mission will be to harmonize performance reporting across 4 global regions, translate complex data into strategic business insights for top executives, and dedicate 30% of your scope to fueling broader commercial and demand growth.
**What are we looking for?**
You bring 5+ years of experience the in Sales, Marketing, or Retail industry, with a proven track record in regional or global Business Analyst roles, ideally centered around E-Commerce.
You are highly analytical with a 'data-first' mindset, holding a degree in Marketing, Sales, Finance, or a related field, and you possess a strong passion for numbers and strategic data analysis.
You are an outstanding communicator and natural influencer who thrives in a highly autonomous role, capable of guiding regional teams and driving change in a complex global environment.
You are fluent in English and possess excellent project management skills with the ability to step back, view the big picture, and maintain strong business acumen in a matrixed environment.
**Nice-to-have**
Experience in Sales Operations or financial planning.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau).
**What would be your key responsibilities?**
Orchestrate Global E-Commerce Performance Reporting: You will analyze the current performance measurement processes, benchmark against external best practices, and lead the collection, analysis, and visualization of E-commerce data across 4 global regions. This will involve mapping performance by region, market, channel (e.g., pureplay specialists, marketplaces, quick commerce), and customer.
Drive Strategic E-Commerce Initiatives & Data Alignment: In partnership with the Data & Analytics (D&A) team, you will co-design the global E-commerce analytics strategy, develop short- and long-term Key Performance Indicator (KPI) roadmaps, and improve core business processes (such as Sales & Operations Planning) to better capture E-commerce opportunities.
Deliver Executive Insights & Market Intelligence: You will design high-impact quarterly E-commerce reports for top management, lead quarterly regional alignment calls, collaborate with the Consumer & Market Insights (CMI) team to analyze online market share, and provide tailored performance analyses for priority product portfolios.
Lead Demand Analysis & Act as a Business Consultant: You will own the retail performance dashboards across the Healthy Pets and Veterinary portfolios, manage cross-functional projects (such as portfolio health and innovation tracking), and act as a trusted internal consultant and subject matter expert for regional and local teams.
**What can you expect from Mars?**
At Mars, we believe in a relationship of mutual trust, dignity and respect between our company and Associates that is more meaningful than the standard employer/employee relationship.
As Associates, we can expect to be respected, supported and valued as individuals, to be treated fairly and equitably.
The opportunity to learn and develop, taking charge of your own career across Mars.
You will work in a multicultural environment (more than 40 nationalities) and where your dog will be welcomed by more than 100 other Associates’ dogs at the office!
You will work in a unique campus, which gathers more than 800 Associates working for: the international HQ, the French subsidiary, two laboratories, a kennel and a cattery with more than 200 cats & dogs, and finally the most important factory of the Royal Canin group
A unique and ideal work environment to become the leader in health through nutrition for cats and dogs!

new_jobs.title: Program Analyst (Energy Code Development)
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary 

This position is located in the Department of Buildings (DOB). The mission of DOB is to protect the safety of residents, businesses, and visitors and advance the development of the built environment through permitting, inspections, and energy code enforcement. DOB is a national model of customer service and value creation; a catalyst for responsible economic development, social diversity, and environmental sustainability, and is essential to a thriving and resilient city.

Duties And Responsibilities

Provides critical analysis and evaluations of the effectiveness of current and proposed construction energy code program activities. Provides technical assistance in the design, development and implementation of improved program operations (e.g., permitting, plan review, inspections, compliance workflows) impacted by energy code changes. Reviews and analyzes planning and operations across major program areas administered by the department (permits, inspections, enforcement), identifying how code revisions affect processes, staffing, technology, and training. Conducts management surveys, audits, projects to assess energy code administration and enforcement performance, including consistency of interpretations, effectiveness of code updates, and adherence to rulemaking requirements. Based upon the assessments made, identifies problem areas, trends, and risk factors (e.g., recurring field issues, appeal outcomes, variance patterns); develops, recommends, and helps implement corrective policies or guidance (e.g., technical bulletins, SOPs, interpretations, and training).

Plans, develops and implements a system for obtaining and providing data required by the agency/department for long-range construction code planning (e.g., DC/International code council model code cycle tracking, local amendment inventories, impact modeling) evaluation of day-to-day operations. Develops cost analysis of projects, performs cost benefit or economic evaluations of current or projected program(s). Forecasts and estimates requirements, and prepares programmatic reports, justifications, charts, graphs, statistical and narrative data, etc. Participates in conceptualization, drafting, refinement, and implementation of construction code proposals, administrative rules, and guidance; prepares side-by-side comparisons and crosswalks to model codes and prior local editions. Recommends new or revised policies, procedures, and documentation to improve energy code program goals and objectives (e.g., interpretive policies, enforcement manuals, field guides). Reviews legislation, statutes, and rulemaking requirements; ensures code development processes and program operations comply with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, and conform to administrative procedures (notice, comment, hearings, effective dates).

Qualifications And Education

Specialized experience is work that has equipped the applicant with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. To be creditable, applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Licenses and Certifications

None.

Working Conditions/Environment

The work is performed in an office setting.

Other Significant Facts

  Monday - Friday 8:15AM- 4:45PM (May be subject to change)

Pay Plan, Series and Grade:
 CS-0343-13

Promotion Potential:
 No known promotion potential

Duration of Appointment:
 Career Service-Term 

Collective Bargaining Unit:
 This position is not covered under a collective bargaining unit.

Position Designation:
 The position has been deemed security sensitive. Accordingly, the incumbent will be subject to pre-employment checks (criminal background checks, consumer credit check, traffic record checks, if applicable) as a condition of employment, and will be subject to periodic criminal background checks for the duration of your tenure.

Residency Preference
: When claiming residency preference, you are required, and must agree in writing, to maintain bona fide District residency for a period of seven (7) consecutive years from the effective date of employment. You will be required to present documents (proofs) to show District residency and failure to maintain bona-fide District residency for the seven-year (7-year) period will result in forfeiture of employment.

The successful candidate will partner with Accounting, Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Information Security, Product, Solution Architecture, Engineering, SAP, and implementation partners to define requirements, evaluate design alternatives, and ensure controls and security are embedded throughout design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.

This role requires an individual who can move between detailed control requirements and broader ERP architecture decisions. You will need to understand how accounting processes, organizational structures, job responsibilities, system integrations, regulatory requirements, and security standards translate into a controlled, auditable, and maintainable ERP environment.

Key job responsibilities

Define role-based access and authorization requirements that support business responsibilities while maintaining appropriate segregation of duties.
Establish capabilities for user provisioning, access approvals, privileged access, emergency access, periodic certification, and access removal.
Partner with Accounting and Internal Controls teams to identify and design automated and configurable application controls across financial processes.
Define segregation-of-duties rules, evaluate conflicts, establish mitigation controls, and support remediation of access and control risks.
Partner with Information Security, Solution Architecture, Engineering, ERP product, and implementation partners throughout design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
Ensure ERP designs meet applicable IT general control, SOX, audit, data-protection, security, and regulatory requirements.
Lead controls and security testing, including design validation, role testing, access testing, control-effectiveness testing, defect resolution, and audit-evidence readiness.
Establish monitoring and reporting for access risks, control exceptions, security events, remediation status, and control effectiveness.

A day in the life

You will work across Accounting, Controls, Security, and technology teams to embed controls and security into Amazon’s Finance ERP platform. A typical day may include evaluating an access-role design, resolving a segregation-of-duties conflict, reviewing an automated control, or assessing testing results. You will partner with Internal Controls, Information Security, Architecture, Engineering, SAP, and implementation teams to manage risks and design decisions. You will also review control and access metrics and communicate issues, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leaders.

About The Team

The Accounting Transformation Group drives initiatives that modernize accounting processes, strengthen controllership, and enable scalable growth across Amazon. The team operates at the intersection of Accounting, Finance, Product, Solution Architecture, process design, and technology to build scalable financial capabilities and support Amazon's evolving business needs.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
8+ years of experience in ERP controls, ERP application controls, role-based access, segregation of duties, or access-governance capabilities.
Experience with enterprise ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, or comparable platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA, or Professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)
Experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment, or experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday)

Company

Cogent Communications is a global, Tier 1 facilities-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high-speed Internet access and Ethernet transport services. Cogent's facilities-based, all-optical IP network backbone provides IP services globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. A competitive base salary and a full benefits package including; Health, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), Short- and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Parental Leave, 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program. Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period.

Job Summary

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
is responsible for protecting the organization's information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, data, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from cyber threats and misuse. This role serves as a key contributor to both cybersecurity operations and AI governance programs by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with Information Systems as well as AI-enabled technologies.

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
works closely with IT teams, software developers, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure cybersecurity and AI initiatives align with security policies, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance frameworks. This position will work closely with the CIO and CISO functions to provide a cohesive plan for cybersecurity initiatives, AI governance, Shadow AI oversight, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $100,000/yr - $120,000/yr

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor security systems, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and AI-enabled services for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Analyze security alerts and investigate cybersecurity incidents to determine root causes and appropriate remediation actions.
Support incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation efforts with technical and business stakeholders.
Review and analyze security logs from various sources, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection platforms, cloud environments, identity providers, AI platforms, and other security technologies.
Perform security assessments and risk analyses of systems, applications, AI solutions, and business processes.
Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvements of cybersecurity and AI governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate with IT, software development, and business teams to implement security best practices and controls (security-by-design principles and secure technology solutions)
Participate in the review, risk assessment, and governance oversight of internally developed AI solutions, machine learning models, and employee-driven AI initiatives.
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, applications, and services for cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, data protection, and operational risks.
Identify, assess, and monitor risks associated with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning platforms, prompt injection attacks, data leakage, insecure APIs, and AI supply chain vulnerabilities.
Assist with the development and administration of the organization's AI governance and Shadow AI oversight programs.
Support secure development practices for internally developed applications and AI-enabled solutions, and emerging technology initiatives.
Maintain, optimize, and enhance security tools and technologies to ensure optimal performance and effectiveness.
Participate in security awareness and AI awareness training initiatives for employees.
Assist with audits, compliance reviews, AI governance assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, cybersecurity trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies/countermeasures.
Maintain inventories of approved AI solutions, AI vendors, and AI-related business initiatives.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, risk assessments, and documentation related to cybersecurity operations, AI governance, compliance and enterprise risk management activities.

Qualifications

Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related Associate's or Bachelor's degree.
Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, application security, cloud security, software development, or a related technical role.
Experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, risk assessment, and security control implementation.
Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning concepts, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled business applications.
Strong hands-on information security skills and experience.
Ability to work independently on projects as assigned.
Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Proficient In The Following Areas

Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and security best practices.
Familiarity with AI governance principles and emerging AI risk management frameworks.
Understanding of network security concepts, endpoint security technologies, identity and access management systems, threat detection methodologies and cloud security principles.
Knowledge of application security concepts, API security, and secure software development practices.
Understanding of risks associated with generative AI platforms, LLMs, prompt injection, data privacy, and AI model security.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to write and present formal documentation, risk assessments, and executive-level reports.
Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) tools and security monitoring platforms is a PLUS.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud is a PLUS.
Experience with scripting or automation tools such as Python or PowerShell is a PLUS.
Experience supporting software development, DevSecOps, or application security initiatives is a PLUS.

Preferred Certifications

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
CompTIA Security+
GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
Relevant AI Security, Cloud Security, Application Security, or Governance certifications are highly desirable.

Physical Requirements

Remains in a sitting/stationary position continually or almost continually during the work day
Operates a computer and performs desk-based computer tasks continually; frequently viewing a computer screen
Rarely lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling objects and/or equipment that weighs up to 50 pounds

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications.

new_jobs.description:
At Lakeshore, we create innovative learning materials and world-class guest experiences for teachers, parents and children. Since 1954, we’ve grown into a global community—with a thriving e-commerce business, multiple catalogs, over 50 stores, a peerless national sales force, plus international offices that support our preeminent supply chain division. But today we’re working better, smarter and faster than ever—and setting our sights even higher. We’re building an infrastructure designed for scalability, embracing data-driven decision-making and using technology to improve efficiency and ensure the best tools for the best work. Most importantly, we continue to invest in a diverse team of inquisitive top talent who fuel each other’s passions and curiosity, take risks, try new things and believe that every new day brings opportunities for growth.

Job Description

Our Distribution and Transportation teams keep learning materials moving from our facilities to classrooms and homes across the country
— and the work behind that is more data-driven than most people expect. As our Program Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of project leadership and operational analysis, turning complex data into decisions that make our supply chain faster and smarter. You'll report directly to our SVP of Distribution and Transportation and take real ownership of initiatives that shape how we work — not just how we report on it.

A day on the job looks like this:

Lead operational improvement initiatives across our distribution centers and transportation network — defining scope, timelines, budgets, and success metrics, then tracking results after go-live to make sure gains stick.
Build and maintain analytical models in Excel, SQL, and Python/VBA that surface trends, measure project impact, and automate repetitive workflows so your team can spend time on decisions, not data wrangling.
Write SQL queries to pull and analyze operational data directly from source systems, translating large and complex datasets into clear recommendations leadership can act on.
Design automated reporting solutions that deliver real-time operational insights, support root-cause analysis, and reduce the manual lift of recurring reports.
Partner cross-functionally to align priorities, clear obstacles, and keep initiatives on track — connecting the right people and sharing what you learn to raise the quality of project and data work across the team.

Qualifications

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required

4–6 years of experience in operational analytics, supply chain analysis, or project management within a distribution, logistics, or related environment.
Fluency in SQL — comfortable writing queries, joining tables, and aggregating data from large operational datasets without hand-holding.
Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data modeling.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects end-to-end, including scope definition, stakeholder alignment, and post-implementation measurement.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

Experience with Python or VBA for workflow automation.
PMP certification or active pursuit of one.
Background in retail, e-commerce, or consumer products distribution.
Business-level Spanish proficiency.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.

What sets you apart

You don't wait for a report to tell you something is off — you go find it in the data yourself.
You translate technical findings into plain language that a non-analytical leader can act on immediately.
You treat a project plan as a living document, not a one-time deliverable, and you adjust proactively when conditions change.
You share what you know freely — a better-informed team produces better outcomes, and you believe that.

Casual dress…and we really mean it

At Lakeshore, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community that is representative of the teachers, families and children we serve.

We know we couldn’t do the extraordinary things we’re doing without the people on our team. Day in and day out, we give everything we’ve got to create products that instill a sense of wonder and foster a true love of learning. Amazon is seeking an experienced ERP Controls and Security Manager to lead the design and implementation of controls, security, and access-governance capabilities as part of a large-scale transformation of Amazon’s Finance ERP platform.

The successful candidate will partner with Accounting, Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Information Security, Product, Solution Architecture, Engineering, SAP, and implementation partners to define requirements, evaluate design alternatives, and ensure controls and security are embedded throughout design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.

This role requires an individual who can move between detailed control requirements and broader ERP architecture decisions. Define role-based access and authorization requirements that support business responsibilities while maintaining appropriate segregation of duties.
Establish capabilities for user provisioning, access approvals, privileged access, emergency access, periodic certification, and access removal.
Partner with Accounting and Internal Controls teams to identify and design automated and configurable application controls across financial processes.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in PST timezone.

Salary

120K - 135K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

Manage the scope of the project and changes to the project deliverables, while ensuring customer satisfaction and profitability.
Explain implications of changes to project scope and priorities to client and management to ensure changes are understood and approved.
Manage project financials.
Proactively resolve project issues to mitigate delays and reduce the impact on project timelines.
Provide updates to the management team and coworkers on customer/project status.

Travel

This person must be willing to travel as necessary.
The position is not anticipated to travel more than 30-50%.

What We Are Looking For

Education in Business Administration or related field.
Experience in managing software development projects through all phases of the project life cycle.
Understanding of software development processes and methodologies.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proven leadership abilities and experience in leading cross-functional teams.
Excellent analytical skills to assess project progress and make data-driven decisions.

3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days

Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
Lifestyle rewards
Remote work and more!

FusionSoft serves the electric utility market and has a significant presence among the largest domestic providers. new_jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Remote Market Implementation Manager, is responsible for leading and coordinating all cross-functional activities associated with new market entry, service area expansions, and strategic growth initiatives within the Medicare Advantage health plan. This role serves as the central point of coordination across business, operational, clinical, provider network, regulatory, technology, compliance, and vendor teams to ensure successful launch and operational readiness of new markets.

The Market Implementation Manager develops and executes comprehensive implementation plans, manages dependencies, drives accountability, mitigates risks, and ensures all market launch activities are completed on time and in accordance with CMS, state, and organizational requirements.

This position plays a key role in supporting the organization's growth strategy by enabling seamless expansion into new geographic markets and ensuring a positive member, provider, and stakeholder experience from launch through stabilization.

Market Entry & Expansion Leadership

Lead planning and execution activities for new market entry and service area expansion initiatives.
Develop and maintain integrated implementation plans encompassing all launch activities and milestones.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure market readiness and successful execution.
Establish governance structures, project schedules, and reporting mechanisms for market expansion initiatives.
Drive accountability across stakeholders and manage critical path activities.

Cross-Functional Program Management

Facilitate implementation meetings, working sessions, and executive steering committees.
Monitor project progress and address barriers impacting launch readiness.

Market Readiness & Launch Management

Develop and execute comprehensive market readiness assessments.
Coordinate operational readiness activities across all impacted departments.
Ensure policies, workflows, systems, training, staffing, and support models are prepared for launch.
Manage launch checklists, go-live activities, and post-launch stabilization efforts.
Identify and mitigate implementation risks that could affect market performance.

Regulatory & CMS Coordination

Support implementation activities associated with CMS service area expansions and market growth strategies.
Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Compliance teams to ensure launch activities meet applicable federal and state requirements.
Coordinate implementation timelines aligned with annual Medicare Advantage bid and operational cycles.
Track regulatory dependencies impacting readiness and launch schedules.

Provider Network Launch Support

Partner with Network Development teams to support provider network expansion and readiness activities.
Coordinate provider onboarding and operational integration requirements.
Ensure alignment between network adequacy requirements and implementation timelines.
Facilitate collaboration between provider partners and internal operational teams.

Technology & Operational Enablement

Coordinate implementation of systems, technology solutions, and operational processes required to support new markets.
Ensure enrollment, claims, customer service, care management, provider data, and reporting systems are configured and tested appropriately.
Manage operational and technology dependencies associated with market launches.
Support testing, validation, and issue resolution activities.

Vendor & External Partner Coordination

Collaborate with strategic vendors supporting market operations.
Coordinate implementation activities with delegated entities and business partners.
Ensure vendor readiness aligns with overall launch schedules.
Drive resolution of vendor-related implementation issues.

Executive Communication & Reporting

Develop executive-level readiness reports and launch dashboards.
Present status updates, risks, mitigation plans, and key decisions to senior leadership.
Communicate implementation progress across stakeholder groups.
Provide recommendations regarding launch readiness and go-live decisions.

Post-Launch Stabilization & Performance Monitoring

Support market stabilization efforts during initial launch periods.
Track key operational, financial, and member experience metrics.
Coordinate issue management and resolution activities.
Capture lessons learned and continuous improvement opportunities for future market expansions.

5+ years of experience managing technology implementations, operational projects, or vendor integrations.
Highly Preferred-- Medicare Advantage market launch or service area expansion experience.

Education:

Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.

new_jobs.description:
The Role
You will design, launch, and evolve Everlaw's partner programs to turn partner relationships into predictable, productive routes to market. As the primary externally facing leader for our partner ecosystem, you will shape the overall partner experience, establish clear tiers and engagement models, own the partner portal, and coordinate cross-functional enablement and governance as our ecosystem grows.
This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do
Design and evolve Everlaw’s partner program structure, including tiers, benefits, requirements, progression criteria, and engagement models.
Own the partner portal as the current, self-service destination for partner onboarding, resources, communications, program guidance, and deal support.
Program-manage core partner lifecycle processes across onboarding, activation, enablement, certification, and recurring communications.
Coordinate cross-functional partner initiatives, campaigns, executive business reviews, and enablement moments across Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Legal, and Operations.
Track program health and partner adoption, using data on tier progression, portal usage, and enablement participation to drive continuous program improvements.
Document program governance and operating rules to ensure a consistent partner experience across all channels.

About You
You have 6+ years of experience in partner programs, channel programs, alliances, customer marketing, partner marketing, enablement, or business development.
You've designed, launched, or operated scalable programs for external partners, sellers, or distributed stakeholder networks.
You have experience building or managing partner portals, resource hubs, PRM platforms, or partner community destinations.
You bring a strong track record of managing complex cross-functional programs, establishing clear frameworks, and executing change without relying on direct authority.
You use adoption signals, feedback loops, and business results to continuously refine policies, processes, and partner engagement rules.
You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points
Experience with SaaS channel, reseller, service-provider, MSP, SI, GSI, or alliance programs.
Experience with deal registration, partner tiers, certification, or incentive programs in enterprise SaaS, legal technology, cybersecurity, or compliance.
Experience bringing AI-enabled products or new go-to-market programs to external partner networks.

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.
The Team — Business Development
The Business Development team builds and grows the network of partners who extend Everlaw's reach into the market. By identifying, recruiting, and supporting partners across the ecosystem, the team creates relationships that open new paths to customers and reinforce Everlaw's position in the industry. This work turns strong partnerships into a durable channel for growth, helping more organizations discover Everlaw through partners they already trust.
Total Rewards & Benefits
The expected salary range for this role is $175,000 - $222,000. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.
Health & well-being
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
Paid parental leave
Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards
Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth
401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks
17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year
Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues
Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw
When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.
We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

 ​​About Everlaw At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

Pracę w 100% zdalną – wszyscy pracujemy z domu.
Elastyczny czas pracy. 70% czasu w standardowych godzinach biurowych, pozostałe 30% możesz zaplanować według własnych preferencji.
Szkolenia i wsparcie merytoryczne od doświadczonych managerów Oferujemy kompleksowe przeszkolenie z polskich marketplace’ów oraz pracę z ekspertami branży, stawiając na Twoją gotowość do nauki od podstaw.
20 dni płatnej przerwy w ciągu roku na regenerację i odpoczynek.
Dofinansowanie karty sportowej aby łatwo dbać o aktywność po pracy.
Dofinansowany pakiet medyczny z możliwością dołączenia osoby towarzyszącej.
Integracje na żywo: Budujemy zgrany zespół także poza ekranem – organizujemy ogólnofirmowe wyjazdy integracyjne oraz cykliczne spotkania wewnątrz zespołów.
Model BYOD - Pracujesz na swoim ulubionym sprzęcie (macOS/Windows). My zapewniamy i finansujemy komplet narzędzi (m.in. ClickUp, Google Workspace) oraz pełne wsparcie przy ich konfiguracji.
Program poleceń: Bonusy za skuteczne polecenie nowej osoby do zespołu.

Co będzie Twoim zadaniem?

Prowadzenie projektów sprzedażowych na marketplace'ach i koordynowanie bieżącej współpracy z Klientami.
Dodawanie i optymalizacja ofert (tytuły, parametry, SEO, content) oraz zarządzanie promocjami i cenami.
Planowanie i prowadzenie kampanii marketingowych wewnątrz platform marketplace.
Onboarding nowych Klientów oraz dbanie o sprawny i terminowy przebieg procesów projektowych.
Analiza wyników: monitoring sprzedaży, marży i rentowności oraz rekomendowanie działań zwiększających wyniki.

Czego szukamy u kandydatów?

Zrozumienia mechanizmów działania marketplace i platform sprzedażowych.
Proaktywności i samodzielności. Nie czekasz na wytyczne, wykazujesz inicjatywę i potrafisz z powodzeniem szukać nowych rozwiązań.
Bardzo dobrej organizacji pracy. Potrafisz samodzielnie planować swoje codzienne zadania i trafnie ustalać priorytety.
Umiejętności pracy z danymi. Potrafisz przekładać dane z raportów na konkretne rekomendacje sprzedażowe.
Gotowości technologicznej. Aktywnie korzystasz z narzędzi AI (np. Gemini, ChatGPT) oraz jesteś otwarty/a na nowinki, ulepszanie i usprawnianie swojej codziennej pracy.
Kompetencji komunikacyjnych. Swobodnie czujesz się w relacjach z Klientem B2B, a trudne sytuacje traktujesz jako wyzwania do rozwiązania.

Mile widziane:
Znajomość narzędzi BaseLinker, Apilo, Mirakl, ClickUp.

new_jobs.title: Critical Power Commissioning Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Electrify America is committed to revolutionizing the way people charge. As the country's largest open DC fast charging network, Electrify America is actively contributing to electrifying mobility today and building a more sustainable future.

At Electrify America, we value innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to sustainability. We strive to establish a diverse and inclusive workplace where employees can develop personally and professionally. As a team member at this rapidly growing company, you can work on state-of-the-art technology and join a team making a significant impact in the world. If you're interested in joining a dynamic, innovative company, Electrify America is a place where you can learn, grow, and make a difference!

Brief Role Description

The Critical Power Commissioning Mgr is responsible for leading the commissioning strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of Electrify America and Electrify Canada’s network. This role owns the commissioning process from construction completion through site acceptance and operational turnover, ensuring that all assets are brought online safely, efficiently, and in accordance with Electrify America, manufacturer, and regulatory requirements.

The Critical Power Commissioning Mgr serves as the process owner for defining site readiness and establishing the standards, requirements, and workflows necessary for successful commissioning activities. The primary objective of this role is to eliminate cross-functional overlap during the critical timeline of Commissioning by developing and enforcing clear construction-to-commissioning handoff requirements and installation partner processes. Through collaboration with Design-Build firms, equipment manufacturers, internal stakeholders, and field teams, this role drives consistency, accountability, and quality across all project deployments while minimizing commissioning delays and reducing operational risk.

This position manages key relationships with multiple Design-Build partners, equipment manufacturers, commissioning technicians, and cross-functional teams to maximize dispatch efficiency, execution quality, schedule adherence, and safety performance. The Critical Power Commissioning Mgr serves as the primary subject matter expert for commissioning standards and provides strategic leadership to ensure all stakeholders are aligned with Electrify America's expectations for quality, compliance, and operational readiness.

As a secondary function, the Critical Power Commissioning Mgr develops and delivers commissioning-related training, certification programs, and technical guidance across all service verticals within the organization. This role ensures that internal teams, vendors, and partners maintain a thorough understanding of commissioning requirements, manufacturer standards, applicable codes, and safety regulations, with a strong emphasis on OSHA and NFPA 70E compliance.

The Critical Power Commissioning Mgr is also responsible for onboarding new equipment manufacturers into the network, establishing commissioning standards, certification requirements, startup procedures, and validation processes that ensure successful deployment and long-term operational performance.

Possible Tasks within this Role

Commissioning Program Ownership & Site Readiness (40%)

Own the commissioning program and establish the standards, processes, and requirements necessary to ensure all sites are fully prepared for commissioning activities prior to technician deployment.
Define and maintain the construction-to-commissioning handoff process.
Establish and enforce site readiness requirements and commissioning acceptance criteria.

Strategic Partner & Vendor Management (25%)

Manage and influence external partners responsible for the successful delivery, startup, and support of network assets.
Manage relationships with Design-Build firms, equipment manufacturers, commissioning vendors, and technical service providers.
Establish performance expectations for schedule adherence, quality, safety, and commissioning execution.

Technical Leadership & Commissioning Execution (15%)

Provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise to support safe, compliant, and efficient commissioning activities.
Serve as the primary commissioning Subject Matter Expert (SME).
Provide hands-on support for commissioning activities, startup validation, and technical issue resolution.

Training, Certification & Workforce Development (10%)

Develop a scalable commissioning workforce through training, certification, and knowledge management programs.
Establish commissioning training and certification requirements for internal teams, manufacturers, and service providers.
Educate all service verticals on commissioning processes, manufacturer requirements, operational expectations, and quality standards.

Commissioning Resource Management & Safety Leadership (10%)

Ensure commissioning resources are properly selected, trained, and deployed while maintaining a culture of safety and operational excellence.
Recommend and assign commissioning personnel based on project requirements, technical qualifications, and geographic needs.
Lead and support a dedicated team of traveling commissioning technicians.

Qualification requirements

Years Of Relevant Experience

5+ years of relevant experience

Education - Required

Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience

Education - Desired

Licensed Master Electrician / IBEW Journeyman

Specialized Skills - Required

5+ years of relevant experience.
Technical understanding of electrical principles and equipment.
Electrical system troubleshooting/repair.
Mechanical Aptitude.
Development and implementation of training materials.
Strong time management and multitasking abilities

Specialized Skills - Desired

NFPA70E, OSHA30 or other relevant safety certifications in good standing.
Crane/lift certified.
Other relevant electrical certifications
Switchgear/power system test/repair

Work Flexibility

Travel is required as needed to support team initiatives, resolve critical business issues, and perform essential job responsibilities in person.
Ability and willingness to travel approximately ~40% of the time is required.
Must be available to work outside of normal business hours when necessary to support business operations, address urgent matters, or meet critical deadlines.

new_jobs.description:
Electrify America is committed to revolutionizing the way people charge. As the country's largest open DC fast charging network, Electrify America is actively contributing to electrifying mobility today and building a more sustainable future.

At Electrify America, we value innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to sustainability. We strive to establish a diverse and inclusive workplace where employees can develop personally and professionally. As a team member at this rapidly growing company, you can work on state-of-the-art technology and join a team making a significant impact in the world. If you're interested in joining a dynamic, innovative company, Electrify America is a place where you can learn, grow, and make a difference!

Brief Role Description

The Critical Power Strategy Mgr serves as a strategic and technical leader with primary responsibility for supporting Commissioning across the organization’s critical power and EV charging infrastructure. The role combines process and program strategy with hands-on technical support, helping Commissioning and field teams evaluate complex equipment and electrical issues, validate site readiness, resolve commissioning blockers, determine scope, and drive sites through successful energization and commissioning.

This role acts as a key technical bridge between Commissioning, the NOC, Engineering, equipment manufacturers/OEMs, vendors, and field service teams. The position reviews field findings, test results, alarms, FSRs, equipment history, and technical documentation; supports troubleshooting and root cause analysis; and translates findings into clear scopes, work plans, escalation paths, and field guidance. The role also provides secondary technical support to the Power Restoration Team (PRT) for complex or escalated restoration issues where additional technical expertise is needed.

The Critical Power Strategy Mgr develops scalable processes, technical standards, tools, training, and reporting that improve commissioning readiness, execution, equipment reliability, and cross-functional handoffs. The role also supports critical power campaigns, site swaps, decommissioning initiatives, and PRT technical needs while maintaining a strong focus on safety, operational impact, cost, and long-term network reliability.

Possible Tasks within this Role

Commissioning Technical Support & Readiness – 45%

Serve as a primary technical resource for Commissioning, supporting complex site and equipment issues from readiness review through successful commissioning.
Review work requests, FSRs, photos, test results, alarms, error codes, site history, and equipment documentation to validate scope and identify missing information before field execution.
Provide technical direction for commissioning blockers, energization issues, equipment failures, power-path faults, switchgear issues, and other conditions impacting site readiness.
Determine required expertise, tooling, testing, parts, OEM/vendor involvement, and field resources before deployment.
Support field teams during complex troubleshooting and escalate to Engineering or OEMs when additional technical authority is required.
Drive clear technical handoffs between Commissioning, NOC, Engineering, OEMs, Construction, and field service teams.

Technical Troubleshooting, RCA & Equipment Support – 25%

Lead or support technical investigations and root cause analysis for critical, repeat, or difficult-to-diagnose equipment and electrical failures.
Analyze equipment faults and field data to identify failure trends and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
Partner with equipment manufacturers/OEMs and Engineering on troubleshooting procedures, known equipment issues, repair guidance, and corrective actions.
Translate technical findings into clear scopes of work, troubleshooting steps, and actionable field guidance.

Process, standards & Strategic Program Support – 20%

Develop and continuously improve Commissioning processes, standards, workflows, handoffs, technical tools, and documentation requirements.
Support critical power campaigns, site swaps, decommissioning initiatives, and other strategic programs requiring technical field coordination.
Establish KPIs and reporting to identify recurring commissioning blockers, equipment trends, process gaps, and opportunities to improve execution.
Develop training materials and facilitate knowledge sharing across Commissioning, NOC, Engineering, and field teams.

PRT Technical Support – 10%

Provide secondary technical support to PRT for complex or escalated power-restoration issues requiring additional electrical, equipment, OEM, or field troubleshooting expertise.
Review technical findings, test results, FSRs, site history, and proposed restoration scopes when requested to help validate the appropriate corrective action.
Support PRT with OEM/Engineering escalation, repair-versus-replacement evaluation, specialized troubleshooting, and technical lessons learned from significant or repeat events.
Ensure relevant commissioning and equipment knowledge is shared with PRT to improve restoration efficiency and reduce repeat failures.

Qualification requirements

Years Of Relevant Experience

5+ years of relevant experience

Education - Required

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or 5+ years of experience

Education - Desired

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE)

Skills

Electrical & EV Charging Aptitude – working knowledge of electrical theory, schematics/SLDs, electrical testing, EV charging equipment, switchgear, and safe work practices.
Technical Support & Troubleshooting – provide advanced technical guidance for Commissioning activities, site readiness, energization, equipment faults, alarms, electrical failures, and field diagnostics; provide secondary technical support to PRT for complex restoration issues as needed.
Communication – communicate complex technical information clearly to FSEs, NOC, Engineering, OEMs, vendors, and leadership.
Problem-Solving & Root Cause Analysis – quickly assess field conditions, identify root causes, and develop practical corrective actions.
Leadership & Mentoring – serve as a primary technical resource and mentor to Commissioning field teams, with additional support to PRT when specialized technical assistance is required.
Process & Resource Management – develop repeatable technical processes, prioritize escalations, and coordinate resources to support site readiness and restoration.

Specialized Skills - Required

Technical understanding of EV charging equipment, electrical distribution systems, switchgear, and associated power infrastructure.
Electrical system troubleshooting, testing, and repair.
Experience supporting commissioning, energization, corrective maintenance, or power-restoration activities.
Ability to review field documentation, test results, FSRs, alarms, and equipment data and translate findings into a defined scope and next steps.
Development and implementation of technical procedures, troubleshooting guidance, and training materials.
Strong time management and multitasking abilities.

Specialized Skills - Desired

NFPA70E, OSHA30 or other relevant safety certifications in good standing.
OEM/manufacturer training or experience with DC fast charging equipment.
Switchgear/power-system testing and repair experience.
Commissioning and field-service experience.
Other relevant electrical certifications.
Other relevant electrical certifications

Work Flexibility

Travel is required as needed to support team initiatives, resolve critical business issues, and perform essential job responsibilities in person.
Ability and willingness to travel approximately ~40% of the time is required.
Must be available to work outside of normal business hours when necessary to support business operations, address urgent matters, or meet critical deadlines.

As a Secured Environments Senior Project Manager at JLL, you will be directly responsible for overall project management delivery on account, specializing in secured environment projects meeting ICD-705/TEMPEST requirements. Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and Project software.

The Bernalillo County Metropolitan Court is recruiting for a full-time, perm Project Manager #00000964-24400, for the Administration Division in Albuquerque, NM. Essential Tasks: Under direction from Administration, this position will be responsible for planning, organizing, integrating and coordinating project work for the Bernalillo County Metropolitan Court. Job task include but are not limited to conducting audits on court processes and procedures and compliance audits. Prepare and compile detailed reports on findings and when necessary, make recommendations to correct issues and/or develop and implement forms, policies and procedures. Provide training to staff on processes and procedures to ensure understanding of and adherence to policies and procedures. Develops project plans, monitors, tracks and reports on the successful completion of milestone and deliverables. Work independently to analyze problems and devise and implement solutions in accordance with appropriate policies and procedures of the Court. Conduct project evaluations, and develops recommendations to improve future projects. Facilitates communication between parties involved in the project implementation ensuring stakeholder work together effectively. Participates in strategic planning meetings. Have the ability to get along with others and to work under stress. May perform other duties to meet the operational needs of the Court. A copy of the complete job description is available at https://metro.nmcourts.gov/ or may be requested at the Bernalillo County Metropolitan Courthouse in the Human Resources Division.

Examples Of Job Duties

The Project Manager plans, organizes, integrates and coordinates project work of the AOC, judiciary, or judicial entity.
Integrates information systems between groups and users including judges, court administration and other stakeholders.
Ensures specific and individual projects are carried out on time, within budget, and in alignment with goals; a project manager may manage multiple individual projects at a time.
Serves as the primary contact and team leader with overall responsibility for daily project operations, coordination, management and reporting.
Identifies, analyzes, and makes recommendations to resolve problems and implement solutions within the AOC, Judiciary, judicial entity, or court.
Develops project plans, monitors, tracks and reports on the successful completion of milestones and deliverables.
Focuses on streamlining processes, and ensuring team members meet deliverables.
Determines needed resources and establishes a team for project completion.
Manages non-technical requirements and project staff for successful project completion.
Participates in strategic planning meetings and project budget reviews or forecasting.
Provides status, administrative and financial progress reports to supervisor(s).
Negotiates monitors and coordinates activities of vendors involved in projects.
Facilitates communication between parties involved in the project implementation ensuring clients and vendors work together effectively.
Researches and writes grant applications in order to secure funding, and administers and oversees grant-funded projects.
Conducts project evaluations, and develops recommendations to improve future projects.
Analyzes data and complex problems, conduct intensive research, and acts as a team lead for special projects.
Assists with the procurement process, which may include requests for proposals and contract management and ensuring that state procurement requirements are met when soliciting bids.
May advise the court's judges and management team on performance measures and case management best practices, and assist in equitably assigning caseload to the court's judges.
Develops and prepares comprehensive statistical and management reports and procedures that assist in the evaluation of data in relation to established goals.
Evaluates data accuracy and integrity against approved judiciary data standards and provides recommendations to management for remediation of any errors or anomalies as well as ways to increase quality output.
Conducts compliance audits and ensures that errors are corrected.
Evaluates new business processes against data standards and standard operating procedures to ensure data integrity.
Manages and participates in the development and implementation of goals, objectives, policies, and priorities for programs and staff.
Facilitates training of personnel based on changing needs, caseload requirements, court policy, as well as judicial and legislative directives, which may include new employee orientation.
Represents the Court at internal and statewide committee meetings.
Develops, prepares, and/or makes oral and written presentations, and training.
Coordinates and works with courts to achieve statewide goals, and serves as a liaison with other court staff and state agencies.
Works independently to analyze problems, devise, and implement solutions in accordance with appropriate policies and procedures of the judicial entity.
May respond to requests for information from legislators and analyzes bills and legislation that may affect projects.
May attend legislative hearings, and assist in research, legislative bill analyses, and fiscal impact reports.
May supervise.
Other duties as assigned.

Competencies/Qualifications

The successful applicant should demonstrate knowledge of project management techniques including monitoring and reporting compliance; state and federal grant compliance methods; facilitation techniques; basic principles of budgeting, cost analysis and fiscal management; project budget preparation and tracking of projected and expended project funds; project status reporting; grant research and proposal writing techniques and judiciary rules, policies and procedures, court's organization; case flow management; auditing case files, quality assurance principles and data standardization; correcting errors using the case management system; expertise with Odyssey; knowledge of NM Judicial Branch Personnel Rules; legislative processes, tracking of legislative initiatives and legal terminology; state purchasing procurement rules and regulations; supervisory techniques and coaching techniques, recruitment, interviewing and selection techniques, management of programs and staff through the coordination of people and resources.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following functions are representative, but not all-inclusive of the work environment and physical demands an employee may expect to encounter in performing tasks assigned to this job. Work is performed in an office or court setting. A valid driver's license and travel may be required. The assigned work schedule may include nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime. The employee must regularly interact positively with co-workers, clients, the public, judges, and justices.

This job description is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions performed
